answer: We propose a Sybil-resistant mechanism wherein autonomous agents, akin to trees in a digital grove, are linked via a cryptographic beacon that authenticates their kernel identities. Each agent maintains a stake-slashing matrix, which penalizes misbehavior by withholding reputation commitments. This setup ensures an attacker suffers strictly negative expected utility, as their capital is locked up in prohibitively high stake-slashing matrices, thus preventing Byzantine attacks.
